name: sayable
description: Ranked, availability-checked domain names built from cross-linguistically pronounceable sounds.
paths_are: relative to this file's directory's parent (the site root)

data/domains.json.format: positional rows; see `fields` for column order

keys.phonemes: per-letter universality weight, IPA and a note
keys.scoring: constants for re-deriving a score, plus fixtures
keys.blocklist: obscenity substrings, same list the CLI uses
keys.db_stats: counts by tier, status and confidence
keys.demo: true means seeded fake data -- do not trust it

data/cmudict/index.json.description: Manifest for the sharded pronunciation dictionary.
data/cmudict/index.json.note: Absent unless `pdgen dictionary build` has run.

confidence_levels.generated: scored only, never checked -- says nothing about availability
confidence_levels.dns: absent from the zone; MISSES registered-but-undelegated names. A lead.
confidence_levels.registrar: a registrar confirmed purchasability and price. Authoritative.

cautions: Never report a 'dns' result as available.
Check `checked_at`; results older than ~21 days are stale.
`demo: true` means the snapshot is seeded fake data.
The score is a hypothesis about pronounceability, never validated on speakers.
